request: Build a Jac library that computes a minimal line diff between two texts, renders it as a unified diff with 3 context lines, and applies a unified diff to the original text. main.jac diffs two files given on the command line.
acceptance: Diffing identical texts gives no changes and an empty unified diff.
Applying diff(a, b) to a always gives back b exactly, including when b has no trailing newline.
Applying a patch whose context lines do not match fails with an error and produces no partial output.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1. This is a Jac library with a command-line entry in main.jac, not a web app.
No network, no external APIs; the library functions are pure and tested with `jac test`.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.

support_files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 with a [project] section (name, version) and entry-point main.jac.
